# cloud-lab

> A documentation-first personal Cloudflare lab framework: capability knowledge tree, proposed interfaces, authority boundaries and staged migration of existing tools.

Tier: ungraded
Status: partial
Interfaces: http, cli, spec
Entrypoint: https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/SDD.md
Auth: Access JWT and per-principal HMAC + server-side scoped grants; first live machine loop verified; full acceptance pending
Spec: https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/contracts/m1.openapi.json

M1 provides a local-tested Worker, SQL outbox, fixed-minute scheduler, Python OS collector and native dashboard. An isolated Access-protected deployment has one validated real runner result; full human/mobile/fault/recovery qualification remains pending. No existing application has migrated. Existing product authorities and runtime boundaries remain unchanged. Document verification does not establish a usable product.

## Interface reference

- [Contracts](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/contracts/README.md): proposed identity, commands, external runs, events, artifacts and recipes.
- [Knowledge tree](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/knowledge-tree.md): capabilities, responsibilities, source implementations and evidence gaps.
- [SUCCESS](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/SUCCESS.md): document milestone and pending product acceptance.

## Optional

- [Architecture](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/architecture.md): state ownership, independent deployment and CF mapping.
- [Migration](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/migration.md): candidate destinations, cutover, rollback and retirement gates.
- [Verification](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/verification.md): M0 document checks and future runtime acceptance.
- [Sources](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/sources.md): pinned public sources and official documentation.

- [Headless OAuth](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/headless-oauth.md): callback paste workflow and evidence-based troubleshooting.
- [Live operations](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/live-operations.md): private receipts, provisioning order and bounded verification.
- [First live evidence](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/evidence/m1-first-live.md): actual runtime, one machine loop and remaining gaps.
- [Isolated restore](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/evidence/m1-isolated-restore.md): real D1 snapshot equality, journal reconciliation and preserved pending work; no production failover.

- [Resident runner](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/resident-runner.md): bounded user-service lifecycle; automatic command pickup and same-journal restart qualified, full recovery pending.
- [Resident evidence](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/evidence/m1-resident.md): 98 tests, independent review and bounded live user-service qualification.
- [Recovery qualification](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/recovery-qualification.md): isolated real-process crash and lost-report harness, with actual local workerd/D1 evidence and explicit remote gaps.

- [Remote recovery and revocation](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/evidence/m1-remote-recovery.md): three isolated real-CF fault cases, revoked grants, disabled test Access token and preserved unknown; original resources unchanged, full acceptance pending.

- [Dashboard browser evidence](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/evidence/m1-dashboard.md): local Chromium/workerd/D1, auth expiry, uncertain retry identity, stale-response rejection and narrow layouts; subsequent reviewed asset rollout verified automatically, real Access/physical mobile pending.

- [Dashboard rollout](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/dashboard-rollout.md): reviewed assets deployed, original settings and application rows retained, anonymous requests return302 and machine reads pass; owner phone workflow pending.
